subject: Request: Reassign trial credits to correct workspace
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@brightpath.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial credits applied to wrong workspace — please reassign

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. I ran a check and it looks like the PLG trial credits Redwood issued for our account applied to our production workspace (org id: org_90210) instead of our staging workspace (org id: org_90211). We started a few integration tests in production and would prefer to have the $5,000 credits moved to staging so the team can run extended evals there.

Details:
- BrightPath account id: acct_BP_3444
- Current credit allocation: +$5,000 to org_90210
- Desired allocation: +$5,000 to org_90211 (staging)
- Promo code / source: PLG-onboard-spring2026 (self-serve)

I've attached a screenshot showing the credits on the production org. Can you confirm whether Redwood can reassign the credit balance between orgs or if we need to open a contract amendment? Ideally this completes before our next test run on Wednesday.

Attachments: screenshot_credit_assignment.png (PNG)

Thanks,
Emma Torres
Finance Ops, BrightPath Inc.
emma@brightpath.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@brightpath.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits applied to wrong workspace — please reassign

Emma — thanks for flagging this. Sorry for the churn.

I can take this to billing and ops immediately. Quick confirmation before I move anything: is org_90211 definitely the staging org you want the credits moved to (one more time for the audit log)? Also confirm that moving the $5k won't conflict with any active invoices or expected renewals this quarter.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Laura (billing) and Dev (finance ops) to confirm the ledger move.
- We will create an internal FIN ticket and audit the credit trace (should be reversible if anything looks off).
- Estimate: 24–48 hours after billing approval.

If that timeline works, confirm org_90211 and I'll mark this high priority.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits applied to wrong workspace — please reassign

Rishi / team —

Thanks for the ping. A couple notes from billing: promotional credits issued via the PLG flow are ledger-level adjustments tied to an account and a target org id. We can reassign credits between orgs on the same account, but we require a short approval from Finance to change ledger entries and an audit CSV for the customer's records.

Can you confirm:
- Full BrightPath account id (acct_BP_3444) — confirmed by Emma above
- Target workspace org id to receive credits — please confirm org_90211 in writing (email ok)
- No pending refunds or invoices tied directly to these credits

Once Dev signs off, billing will perform the transfer and attach the CSV audit to the account. I will also log the change in our billing notes and notify CS.

Laura Bennett
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits applied to wrong workspace — please reassign

Laura / Rishi — approving transfer. I've reviewed the trace for promo id PLG-onboard-spring2026 and confirmed the original allocation event (evt_78f3) targeted org_90210. Per the internal policy, moving credits between orgs on the same account is allowed for promotional grants.

Actions I'll take now:
- Create FIN ticket FIN-9876 and run the ledger migration script (idempotent).
- Produce the audit CSV (attached) showing pre/post balances and event ids.
- Expected wall time: changes propagate within 2 hours; visibility in the UI can be up to 3 hours depending on cache.

Audit attachment: credit-audit-20260301.csv (CSV)
Internal trace id: trace_FIN_evt_78f3_reassign

I'll update FIN-9876 when complete and paste the HubSpot note for the deal.

— Dev Patel
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@brightpath.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits applied to wrong workspace — please reassign

Emma — quick update and confirmation: we completed the transfer this morning. Details below.

Summary:
- Source org (org_90210) production: credits decreased by $5,000
- Target org (org_90211) staging: credits increased by $5,000
- Audit file attached: credit-audit-20260301.csv
- Expected UI visibility: immediate; some cached pages may update within 2–3 hours.

Quoted for context:
> On 2026-03-02 10:15, Dev Patel wrote:
> Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>: approving transfer. I've reviewed the trace for promo id PLG-onboard-spring2026 and confirmed the original allocation event (evt_78f3) targeted org_90210.

If you could confirm you see the +$5,000 on org_90211 that would be great. I've attached a confirmation screenshot from our side as well. If anything looks off I can open FIN-9876 for rollback, but the migration script validated checksums before commit so this should be final.

Thanks for the quick confirmation earlier — glad we got this turned around.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
